metric: EasyEdit native token-accuracy: ES=rewrite, PS=rephrase(generalization), NS=locality; score=harmonic mean

in_context.note: RAG: strong efficacy; NS drops because prepended fact-context shifts neighborhood predictions too.

finetune.note: 25 AdamW steps/fact: locality collapses to ~0 (catastrophic forgetting).

ROME.note: ROME's designed use case: single edits. Near-perfect efficacy + strong locality, as published.

MEMIT.note: single-edit rewrite_acc=0.0 under EasyEdit's default gpt2-xl config (5-layer spread tuned for BATCH editing; the update is too diffuse to flip a single fact). MEMIT's proper result is on the multi-subject BATCH benchmark, where it was the best weight-editor (eff 0.33, loc 0.67).

inlay.note: ES perfect (addressing works); PS low = paraphrase weakness (known); NS 0.69 = gate sometimes fires on same-relation neighbors.
